```yaml
name: Discover New CLAUDE.md Files
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 2 * * *'  # Run daily at 2 AM UTC
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  discover-claude-files:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: |
          pip install requests pygithub

      - name: Discover New CLAUDE.md Files
        id: discover
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          import os
          import json
          import requests
          from github import Github
          
          # Initialize GitHub client
          g = Github(os.environ['GITHUB_TOKEN'])
          
          # Search for repositories with CLAUDE.md files
          query = "filename:CLAUDE.md repo:josix/awesome-claude-md"
          search_results = g.search_repositories(query)
          
          # For demonstration, we'll create a mock list of candidate repos
          # In practice, this would involve searching GitHub API for new CLAUDE.md files
          candidate_repos = [
            "anthropics/claude-api",
            "openai/openai-python",
            "microsoft/semantic-kernel"
          ]
          
          # Save candidate repos to a file
          with open('candidate_repos.txt', 'w') as f:
              for repo in candidate_repos:
                  f.write(f"{repo}\n")
          
          print(f"::set-output name=candidates::{len(candidate_repos)}")

      - name: Create Issue for New Candidates
        if: steps.discover.outputs.candidates > 0
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          script: |
            const fs = require('fs');
            const candidateRepos = fs.readFileSync('candidate_repos.txt', 'utf8').trim().split('\n');
            
            const issueTitle = "New CLAUDE.md Files Discovered";
            let issueBody = "The following repositories contain CLAUDE.md files that may be relevant for inclusion:\n\n";
            
            for (const repo of candidateRepos) {
              issueBody += `- [${repo}](https://github.com/${repo})\n`;
            }
            
            issueBody += "\nPlease review these candidates for potential inclusion in our collection.";
            
            await github.rest.issues.create({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              title: issueTitle,
              body: issueBody,
              labels: ['enhancement', 'automation']
            });

      - name: Update Documentation
        run: |
          echo "# Discovery Process" > docs/discovery-process.md
          echo "" >> docs/discovery-process.md
          echo "This document describes how new CLAUDE.md files are discovered automatically." >> docs/discovery-process.md
          echo "" >> docs/discovery-process.md
          echo "## How It Works" >> docs/discovery-process.md
          echo "- Scheduled daily searches for repositories containing CLAUDE.md files" >> docs/discovery-process.md
          echo "- New findings are reported via GitHub Issues for community review" >> docs/discovery-process.md
          echo "- Community members can then decide whether to add these to the collection" >> docs/discovery-process.md
          echo "" >> docs/discovery-process.md
          echo "## Last Updated" >> docs/discovery-process.md
          echo "$(date)" >> docs/discovery-process.md

      - name: Commit Documentation Changes
        run: |
          git config --local user.email "action@github.com"
          git config --local user.name "GitHub Action"
          git add docs/discovery-process.md
          git commit -m "docs: update discovery process documentation" || echo "No changes to commit"

      - name: Push Documentation Changes
        uses: ad-m/github-push-action@master
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          branch: ${{ github.ref }}
```
